commands: Focused argv: focused-final-command.json; source-owner correction: style-owner-green-command.json
Independent exact commands: core/STATE.json, native-observation/watcher-receipt.md, ui-review/final-product-receipt.json
Full-host producers: checks/notifications_live_* scripts and authenticated response records in gui-live
could_not_verify: Full suite remains FAIL: 8,052 passed, ten failed, 392 skipped. Same ten failing names as M4. Nine unchanged-source reproductions exist; one nested comparison remains incomplete.

Native and full-panel tests cover Houdini 22.0.400, tiny in-process TOP work and foreground cache output only. Background Save to Disk execution, long simulations, external farm discovery, other versions and artist Escape cancellation are unqualified.

Generic SOP range completion is unsupported. Clean ROP PostRender means observed activity ended, not a verified complete range. A cancel request is not proof that work stopped. Unknown outcomes are visible and never relabeled Finished.

TOP Finished requires a bounded final inventory of cooked nodes and successful/cached items. Output content or image quality is not validated. More than 32 watches, 256 graph nodes or 4096 retained items cannot be fully observed.
Desktop alerts default off. Independent native Qt tests intercept and inspect a generic send attempt; actual Windows delivery, user notification settings and retention are unqualified.

Events are bounded process-local memory and survive panel reopen, not process exit. Retention loss is visible. Automatic producers and native watches retain distinct identities; no path/time heuristic merges them.

Computer Use observed the Events entry point and displayed outcomes. Most live interactions used a native Qt harness through the authenticated isolated bridge; a complete manual mouse/keyboard production workflow is not claimed.
Changes are saved on an isolated local branch. The artist installation, original scene and master checkout were not replaced. Merge, release and deployment are separate work.

independent_review.verdict: GO with explicit limits: 25 native Qt behavior cases (44 assertions), nine geometry cases (372 assertions), seven native watcher cases, independent live-receipt inspection, and root review of core/native watcher source.

measurement_notes: The first full-host cache result formatter called the integer st_size as a function after its operational assertions. Both failures are preserved; changing only the formatter/property and output names passes.
Actual host scale2.25 revealed clipping missed by the initial 1/1.25 review. Native form wrapping and the shared style owner are qualified separately on fresh source.
The first full suite had one additional M5 styling-owner failure. It was fixed forward without a test exemption or changed residual budget.
The first indexed Computer Use click landed on Recipes. A fresh observed-coordinate click opened Events; neither action sent a prompt.
proved_it_bites: Twelve final core mutants caused 40 assertion failures; five native watcher mutants were killed. The prior UI fails 53 scale assertions and seven behavior assertions. Saved preferences and QSS private-color falsifiers fail. The unchanged ownership ratchet exposed the private styling sites.
summary: Session-local Events, shared quiet policy, supported native job observations and readable high-DPI controls passed bounded independent and live Houdini checks.

baseline.nested_check: Same ten failing names as the prior full run. Nine baseline reproductions are saved in checks/base-known-failures.log; the nested baseline child stalled and that comparison remains incomplete.

live_houdini.detail: Four final UI/command cases, six native-job/interaction cases (cache in corrected follow-up), and one real local metadata connection scenario.
